q: The partition function Z = Σ e^{−E_i/kT} in statistical mechanics relates to information theory through the free energy F = −kT ln Z, which equals:
opts: −kT times the log-normalizer of the Gibbs distribution (Helmholtz free energy = negative log-sum-exp of energies)
The KL divergence from the uniform distribution
exp: F = −kT ln Z is the Helmholtz free energy. From an information-theoretic view, F = E[E] − T·S where S = kH is the thermodynamic entropy. The Gibbs distribution minimizes free energy, equivalently maximizes entropy at fixed mean energy.
